= Backlog execution round 56 — MLS metasearch and tax-lien/e-file review (2026-11-04) =

== Scope ==

Continue the open research work on real-estate MLS discovery and GitHub tax-lien/e-file software, then reconcile what can and cannot move forward from the broader backlog. No account integration, live provider call, remote sync, scraping, or legal/financial implementation was authorized or performed.

== Completed in this round ==

1. **GitHub tax-lien/e-file review:** documented the distinction between tax-lien investing tools, jurisdiction-specific court forms, court e-filing infrastructure, IRS 1099 generation, and Tax Court case management in [`github-tax-lien-and-efile-software-review-2026-11-04.md`](github-tax-lien-and-efile-software-review-2026-11-04.md). No reviewed GitHub project was established as a general, production-ready tax-lien and tax-return filing system.
2. **MLS/metasearch review:** documented that `libresearch.space` is a listed public SearXNG instance and compared its published availability/latency snapshots with a small sample of other instances in [`mls-metasearch-and-reso-access-review-2026-11-04.md`](mls-metasearch-and-reso-access-review-2026-11-04.md). A public configuration mirror indicates `/search` may be challenged, so automated availability was not established. Authorized MLS/RESO access remains a separate requirement.
3. **No unauthorized data movement:** no MLS, contact, badge, account, or tax data and no provider credentials were used. Directory Desk remains local/offline; this research does not authorize cross-app sync.
4. **Wiki bundle held for privacy review:** the Wiki-in-a-Jar build script packages every root and `docs/` Markdown file. The existing corpus contains Google Drive references, so the bundle was not regenerated in this round rather than republishing potentially private links. The source index and research notes are updated, but the existing bundle does not yet include these new notes. Resolve a privacy-safe redaction/allowlist policy before the next bundle build.

== Wider backlog status — still open where gated ==

The repository’s wider multi-stream backlog is **not complete**. This round closes only the two research deliverables above. Prior completed work, including the Wiki in a Jar repair and the merged Directory Desk changes, remains complete as recorded in the repository; this note does not reopen it.

== Boundaries and next step ==

- This round used GitHub-hosted sources only for the research where applicable. `libresearch.space` and other non-GitHub sites were not directly queried from the workspace; uptime figures are monitoring snapshots, not an interactive search test.
- Do not mark the full backlog done. The next unblocked step is to choose one of the gated threads and provide its missing non-secret scope information or an authorized source capture/relay. For MLS work, do not send credentials—identify only the target MLS/provider and access type.
